messages:
mina: Quick report from onboard smoke for mariner-v2 (quant=q4_k). Noticing punctuation mirroring and bracket swaps in ja-JP vertical samples and some RTL locales. Posting a couple of quick artifacts.

arlo: reproducible example please?

mina: eval cmd I ran:
```
./tools/run_eval --model mariner-v2 --quant q4_k --suite multilang:translate_smoke --locales ja-JP,zh-CN,he --out /tmp/mariner_q4_smoke.jsonl
```

mina: sample A (ja-JP vertical):
- src: "\u7d42\u4e86\uff08\u65e5\uff09 9/2"
- ref: "Ends (Sun) 9/2"
- mariner-q4: "Ends \uff09\u65e5\uff08 9/2"  <-- mirrored parens and order swap around japanese char

sunil: that looks like mirrored glyph insertion during detok. Any token dumps?

mina: token dump (pre-detok): ["\u7d42\u4e86","\uff08","\u65e5","\uff09"," ","9","/","2"]
mariner-q4 detok stream: ["\u7d42\u4e86","\uff09","\u65e5","\uff08"," ","9","/","2"]

arlo: pre-detok streams identical to baseline q8?

mina: yes, q8 and q5 baselines show correct order; q4_k detok differs. Bisecting detok code now.

L10n-bot: /report model=mariner-v2 quant=q4_k suite=multilang:translate_smoke delta_bleu_ja=-0.15 delta_bleu_he=-0.6 samples=400

sunil: quick grep found detok/normalizer.c recent change adding mirror_fallback path. Might be enabled only in the q4_k build.

infra-bot: rolling route override created: locales ja-JP and he -> mariner-v2-q8 until fix.

arlo: plan: run minimal detok unit with and without mirror_fallback flag and compare outputs. If flag is root cause, patch config for q4_k packs.

mina: filed ticket ML-ONBOARD-520 with artifacts and bisect notes. Will paste PR when ready. Keep an eye on other RTL locales.
